key_point: Lara Croft almost wasn't Lara at all
title: Lara Croft almost wasn't Lara at all
caption: Tomb Raider's hero was first planned as a man. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #tombraider #coredesign

instagram.caption:
Tomb Raider was going to star a male adventurer.

Toby Gard at Core Design feared it would look like an Indiana Jones copy, so he switched to a female hero. She was first called Laura Cruz.

The name became Lara Croft, a British aristocrat, and she became one of the most famous characters in gaming.

Can you imagine Tomb Raider without Lara?
